provenance.transactions_count: counted by eye from the rendering: 2 under CHECKS, 3 under OTHER DEBITS, 5 under CREDITS

notes: Held out from tuning (SPEC §10.1). Four scanned pages, read by OCR. The hardest of the samples: sections rather than columns (CHECKS / OTHER DEBITS / CREDITS), yearless MM-DD dates, and a CHECKS section that prints TWO transactions per line (NUMBER DATE AMOUNT NUMBER DATE AMOUNT). The row model reads one transaction per line, so those are missed — recorded here as a real gap rather than smoothed over.
